title: Pale Vault Glacier - Aurora Vault
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band, deliberately glacial (72 BPM is gbc tempo floor - benign feel). Suspended C major: no firm thirds, sus2 (D) and sus4 (F) colour. Vesper motif FROZEN/STRETCHED: the spine slowed to long suspended tones (G3->C4->D4 lift over bars 1-2, settle E... hangs on D=sus2 and never lands the tonic firmly). Wide noise 'aurora swoosh' (crash swell) every 4 bars in place of a beat. 16-bar loop; last bar holds D (sus2) -> resolves up into bar-1 G lift.

tracks._note: slow sparse glassy chime-melody, a few long notes per phrase, lots of rest. The stretched Vesper spine.
